_comment: Advisory trigger evals — deterministic keyword match, not merge-gating. Should-trigger cases cover both routes: story-commercial (actor/presenter-led ad) and product-hero (no one on screen). Negatives must route elsewhere: generating-ugc-videos (phone-real creator testimonial), generating-videos (general video / b-roll / animate a photo), generating-product-photos (product still), generating-images (still), generating-audio (voiceover alone).
